# AurumAI — External Disclosure Boundary

## Safe current claims

- institutional financial-intelligence project;
- initial focus on gold and macro markets;
- deterministic and explainable design;
- evidence-backed reasoning and decision path;
- knowledge graph, forecasting, risk, paper-trading, lineage, OOS, and experiment infrastructure;
- active operational validation.

## Require current artifacts

- predictive accuracy;
- profitability;
- Sharpe/alpha;
- live-trading performance;
- production readiness;
- superiority versus benchmarks.

## Prohibited positioning at the current stage

Do not describe AurumAI as a proven profitable trading bot, autonomous live trader, guaranteed investment system, or validated alpha engine.

## Recommended wording

> AurumAI is an institutional financial intelligence platform designed to transform historical and current economic information into deterministic, explainable, evidence-backed market assessments. Its current engineering phase is focused on rigorous out-of-sample and operational validation before any live execution capability is considered.
